[[File:Gold and Silver - Limited Edition Collection.png|thumb|Gold and Silver - Limited Edition Collection]] [[File:Gold and Silver - Limited Edition Collection angled.png|thumb|Angled cover image]] The '''Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver - Limited Edition Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set that was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on December 7, 2016 and in New Zealand on December 1, 2016. This DVD set is also referred to as the '''Pokémon Gold and Silver Collector's Set''' in promotional material. It contains 18 discs with 157 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7572. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning. A similar DVD set was released in a more slim design as the '''Pokémon The Series: Gold And Silver The Collection''' by [https://shock.com.au/ Shock Entertainment] in Australia on November 2, 2021 with the catalogue number KAL5760B. It contains 18 discs with 157 episodes across them combined. It contains all of the dubbed episodes from ''[[Original series|Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver]]''.
